about: Films that belong together. A work is a set of films about one thing, in the order they were made or the order to watch them, each with its role and one sentence on how it follows from the one before. registry/build_films.py reads this file into registry/films.js; films.html, the Futuretown page, the kit and the Bolas pages show it. Add a work when a second film appears for the same card, program or idea. A film with no entry is a work of one.

works.title: À l'école, three films
works.line: The school card is the only card with more than one film. They are three different questions asked of the same room: what does one operator make of the card, what does an older film style make of it, and what does the game look like on clean plates. The Town cartoon (below) also contains it.

members.note: Terry Gilliam's cutout metamorphosis: the card cut into three pieces, a head comes off and a book opens on a filmed classroom.
The art department's first call sheet made real: the same card as a 1907 trick-film tableau, with the stars of The Eclipse re-printed in its inks.
Version 9 on Watson's clean plates: the whole class as layers, and a lectern under the machine. The film is the game played by a script.

works.title: The crash-test family, in three films
works.line: From a first pencil test of ball-and-cord figures to the full measured bay. Each film adds what the one before could not do.

members.note: Three experiments acted by ball-and-cord figures.
One skeleton must walk, reach, lift, slip, sulk and swoon: 47 proofs.
132 vignettes in a measured bay, each scored for weight, feet, hands and contact.

works.title: CINEOSIS, in five passes
works.line: The same 45 signs of Deleuze's cinema books, performed again each time with less machine and more hand: first in the bay, then fitted into six archive clips by hand, then into 84 by an automatic pipeline, then by hand into all of them with blind review, and finally a making-of. The three reels are cuts of the handmade film.

members.note: All 45 signs over 59 measured worlds; no archive footage yet.

works.title: The Found Odyssey: finding the look
works.line: Before the episodes: how the drawn cast should meet archive footage. Three first shots, six ways to draw them, the chosen way, and the first cut of an episode opening. These led to the seven episodes.

works.title: The Found Odyssey: seven episodes
works.line: One book of the Odyssey per episode, each running one formal experiment. Watch them in order or in any order.

works.title: WYGWYL, from one ink cel to a poem
works.line: The paper poet's build, in the order it was made: one ink cel, two looks, the jointed poet over his own plates, then a whole poem made by the automatic pipeline.

relations.text: Futuretown runs the CINEOSIS path the other way round: archive footage from the same cineosis-lab library, but brought into the card through a surface it already has, instead of a dummy walked into the footage.
The Town's doodle layer and the paper poet are both cut-out puppets over archive footage; WYGWYL's rig is the older of the two.
